__comment: No meteors/ore in a void world - keystone bridge is the skyblock entry into AE2. Inscriber presses come from quest rewards. SHAPED, not shapeless: all four keystone bridges (certus/fluorite/osmium/uraninite) used the identical shapeless set of 1 keystone + 2 sky dust, so Minecraft only ever matched the first one and the other three were uncraftable. Same cost, distinct arrangement.
